settings.hero_image_alt: Rasasi Perfumes at The Fragrance Secrets UAE
settings.intro_text: Rasasi is one of Dubai's most iconic fragrance houses, a family-owned Emirati brand that has become one of the UAE's foremost names in perfumery. The Fragrance Secrets brings together authentic Rasasi perfumes for men and women, from the hugely popular Hawas range to the elegant Shuhrah and La Yuqawam lines. Blending traditional Arabian ingredients like oud, amber, and saffron with modern, refined composition, Rasasi crafts fragrances known worldwide for quality, luxury, and elegance. If you want established Arabian craftsmanship with global appeal, Rasasi is a house to explore.

settings.title: An Iconic Dubai House
settings.body: A family-owned Emirati house born in the heart of Dubai, Rasasi has grown into one of the UAE's foremost fragrance companies, with a worldwide reputation built on quality, luxury, and elegance.

settings.title: Bestselling Signatures
settings.body: Rasasi is loved for the fresh, versatile Hawas range for men and women, the prestige Shuhrah line, and refined creations like La Yuqawam, Daarej, and Fattan, spanning fresh, oriental, and oud styles.

settings.title: East Meets West
settings.body: Rasasi blends traditional Arabian ingredients, oud, amber, saffron, and rose, with modern, refined perfumery, creating both oriental and occidental lines that have won a wide following across the world.

settings.title: Quality & Longevity
settings.body: Known for premium raw materials and expert craftsmanship, Rasasi fragrances deliver strong performance and lasting wear, offering luxury-level quality at prices that respect the customer.

settings.question: Is Rasasi a good perfume brand?
settings.answer: Yes. Rasasi is one of the UAE's foremost fragrance houses, a family-owned Dubai brand with a worldwide reputation for quality, luxury, and elegance, loved for ranges like Hawas.

settings.question: What is Rasasi's most popular perfume?
settings.answer: Rasasi's Hawas range is among its most popular, a fresh, versatile line for men and women. The Shuhrah and La Yuqawam collections are also widely loved for their elegance.

settings.question: Where are Rasasi perfumes made?
settings.answer: Rasasi is a family-owned fragrance house based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It blends traditional Arabian ingredients with modern perfumery to create both oriental and occidental fragrance lines.

settings.question: Do Rasasi perfumes last long?
settings.answer: Yes. Made with premium raw materials and expert craftsmanship, Rasasi fragrances are known for strong performance and lasting wear, performing especially well in warm climates like the UAE.

settings.question: Are Rasasi perfumes authentic at The Fragrance Secrets?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Rasasi perfume at The Fragrance Secrets is 100% authentic and sourced through trusted suppliers, sealed and quality-checked, so you can shop with complete confidence.

settings.question: Do you ship Rasasi perfumes internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. The Fragrance Secrets delivers Rasasi perfumes across the UAE and also ships to customers in the USA and Canada. Shipping options and delivery estimates are available during checkout.
